stem: A truck starts from rest down a hill with a constant acceleration. It achieves 400 meters in 20 seconds. If the weight of the truck is 7 tons then what will be the force acting on it?
expl: For motion with uniform acceleration, the equation is: s = ut + ½at² Here, since u = 0: s = ½at² So, 400 = ½ × a × (20)² 400 = ½ × a × 400 400 = 200a 400 a= =2m/s2 200 Therefore, the acceleration of the truck is: a = 2 m/s² Now, according to Newton’s second law of motion: F = ma Mass = 7 tonnes = 7000 kg So, F = ma = 7000 × 2 = 14000 N Thus, the force acting on the truck will be 14000 N.

stem: If the spinning speed of the earth increases, then the weight of the body at the equator will

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: On a rotating body, at the equator, a centrifugal force acts. This force acts against gravitational force, due to which a decrease in weight is observed at the equator. Note–At the equator, the centrifugal effect arises due to rotation.

stem: The weight of an object when measured on the Earth's surface is 100 N. What will be its weight when measured on the Moon's surface?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Compared to the Earth, gravity on the Moon is about 1/6 as much. Therefore, an object’s weight on the Moon is 1/6 of its weight on Earth. = Weight = (WeightonEarth) = (1/6) × 100 = 16.7 N

stem: Two objects of different masses falling freely near the surface of the Moon would

options.label: b
options.text: undergo a change in their inertia

options.label: c
options.text: have same velocity at any instant

expl: In free fall, the acceleration g is independent of mass. The relation for velocity is v = u + gt, so velocity depends not only on initial velocity (u) and time (t). Hence, if two objects are released together from the same point (neglecting air resistance) under identical initial conditions (e.g., u = 0), then at any instant their velocities will be the same.

stem: You are standing in an elevator. The force exerted by your weight on the floor of the elevator

options.label: a
options.text: will be zero when the lift goes up with an acceleration of 9.8 m/s2.

options.label: b
options.text: will be zero when the lift comes down with an acceleration of 9.8 m/s2.

options.label: c
options.text: Zero when the lift moves in any direction with an acceleration of 9.8 m/s2.

options.label: d
options.text: will not be affected by the change in the rate of acceleration of the lift.

expl: When the elevator comes downward with acceleration 9.8 m/s², the person exerts no pressure on the lift floor because Earth’s gravitational acceleration is 9.8 m/s². Hence, at that time, the force exerted by the person on the floor becomes zero.

stem: The acceleration due to gravity on the Earth's surface is approximately -

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The acceleration due to gravity on the Earth’s surface is approximately 9.8 m/s²; it is denoted by g. Acceleration due to gravity is an example of a vector quantity.

stem: If a feather, a rubber ball and a wooden ball are falling freely simultaneously from the same height in the vacuum then

options.label: a
options.text: The feather will reach the ground first

options.label: b
options.text: The rubber ball will reach the ground first

options.label: c
options.text: The wooden ball will reach the ground first

options.label: d
options.text: All three will reach the ground together

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: In vacuum, air resistance is zero. Therefore, if a feather, a rubber ball and a wooden ball are dropped freely together from the same height, all three will reach the ground at the same time, because their final velocity (v= 2gh) will be independent of their masses.

stem: There is no atmosphere on the surface of the moon because

options.label: b
options.text: Escape velocity of gas molecules is less than RMS velocity

expl: The Moon’s escape velocity is low, so the RMS speed of gas molecules becomes equal to or greater than it, so they escape into space. Hence, an atmosphere like Earth’s is not found on the Moon.

stem: When a stone is brought from the surface of the moon to the earth, then :

options.label: b
options.text: Its weight will change, but mass will not change

options.label: c
options.text: Both weight and mass will change

options.label: d
options.text: Neither mass nor weight will change

expl: When a stone is brought to Earth from the Moon, its mass remains constant, but its weight increases because gravitational acceleration on Earth is greater than on the Moon.

stem: When a film of soap appears on water during the day, it shows beautiful colors. The reason for this phenomenon is-

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / more than one of the above

expl: During the day, the soap film on water appears beautiful and colorful due to interference of light waves.

stem: The conversion of a solid directly into gas is called as :

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Sublimation is the process in which a solid changes directly into the gaseous state without changing into a liquid. The direct change from gas to solid is called deposition; for example, in winter, water vapor changes directly into ice (solid).

stem: Which of the following do spray bottles used as window or household cleaners or perfume sprayers work on?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Such spray bottles as window or household cleaner or per-fume sprayers work on Bernoulli’s principle. Bernoulli’s principle was given by the Swiss mathematician Daniel Bernoulli.

stem: A piece of ice is floating in a beaker containing water up to its brim. When the whole of the ice melts -

options.label: a
options.text: the water will spill on the floor

options.label: b
options.text: the water level will come down in the beaker

options.label: c
options.text: the water level will first fall and then it will spill out of the beaker

options.label: d
options.text: the water level will not change

options.label: e
options.text: none of the above / more than one of the above

expl: A floating piece of ice displaces water equal to its own weight. After melting, the melted water corresponds to the same displaced amount; therefore, the water level does not change.

stem: Spherical form of a raindrop is due to –
expl: The spherical form of a raindrop is due to surface tension. Surface tension is the result of molecular attraction. Rain-drops and drops of molten metal are spherical because their surface tends to contract to the minimum surface area, and for a given volume, a sphere has the minimum surface area.

stem: The highest viscosity among the following is of :

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: The thicker a fluid is, the higher its viscosity. The viscosity of honey and glycerin is higher than that of water. In the given options, the order of viscosity is as follows— honey > blood > water > air.

stem: Food gets cooked faster in a pressure cooker because -

options.label: a
options.text: water starts boiling at low temperature due to high pressure

options.label: b
options.text: water starts boiling at high temperature due to high pressure

options.label: c
options.text: water starts boiling at low temperature due to low pressure

options.label: d
options.text: water starts boiling at high temperature due to low pressure

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Food gets cooked faster in a pressure cooker because, due to high pressure, water starts boiling at a higher temperature inside it. In open utensils, water boils at 100°C, whereas in a pressure cooker the boiling temperature (boiling point) becomes about 120°C.
